title: Work budget polynomial bound
statement: Let $n,a,d,s$ be positive integers with $2a\le d$ and $s\ge1$, set $\varepsilon=a/d$, and define $R=(n+1)(s+1)/\varepsilon$. The deterministic Goldreich–Levin work budget for these parameters is at most $2^{170}R^{100}$.
